objective: Reduce the number of Ghost Imaging measurement shots required to recover the structural information contained in the existing 10,000-shot reference.

reference.display_and_metric_form: clipped to [0,1] (as in all earlier phases)
reference.acquisition: pattern seed 2026, i.i.d. Bernoulli(0.5) 64x64 binary patterns, noise-free buckets, 10,000 shots

low_shot_inputs: first N measurements of the same sequence, same DGI method, clipped to [0,1]; N in 500/1000/2000/5000

training.pairs: input = DGI-N from the first N shots of a random sequence; target = DGI-10000 of the SAME sequence (identical pipeline)
training.sequences: pool of 32 independent sequences per training image; seed = 20,000,000 + 1000*k + train_index (k=0..31); one realisation drawn per image per epoch (deterministic, master seed 0)
training.noise: none - the fixed reference acquisition is noise-free, so its prefixes are too
training.optimiser: Adam lr 1e-4, MSE loss, batch 16, max 80 epochs, early stopping patience 10 on selection loss
training.checkpoint_selection: 75 validation images x seeds 2040-2042 (shared sequence per seed); target = DGI-10000 of that seed

methods_compared_to_reference: conventional DGI-N (same method as the reference)
smoothed DGI-N (Gaussian sigma tuned on training sequences to match their 10k reference)
metrics: edge r = Pearson correlation of Sobel gradient-magnitude maps (skimage.filters.sobel)
secondary_context: all methods also scored against the clean onion image (not the target)

comparable_criterion.definition: AI-N is comparable to the 10k reference if, on paired image-level differences [metric(AI-N, ref) - metric(independent 10k, ref)] pooled over the validation evaluation seeds (2026-2029), the lower bound of the 95% bootstrap CI (2000 resamples over images) is >= -delta, for BOTH SSIM and Pearson r
comparable_criterion.decided_on: validation set; the minimum successful N is frozen before the test set is opened
comparable_criterion.test_set: the same rule is applied once to the 74 test images; N is not changed after seeing test results
